summary:
MacBook Air won't boot, died after a spill, or you've accidentally deleted or wiped important files? Your data may still be recoverable.

We recover data from dead logic boards, failed SSDs and liquid-damaged machines, on Intel and M-series MacBook Airs. Data recovery starts from R900.

Drop it off at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte, or book our R300 door-to-door collection anywhere in Gauteng. Outside Gauteng, we arrange courier collection nationwide.

Every job starts with a free diagnostic and a clear price, and comes with a 6-month warranty.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
